acts.t: Southern Guild  at The Aspen Art Fair 2024
acts.q: Curated by Laura Smith Sweeney of LSS Art Advisory, the exhibition encompasses a rich interplay of textures and materiality by 12 artists, including three from Southern Guild: Zanele Muholi, Stanislaw Trzebinski and Luyanda Zindela.
